translated_title: Exhibition on Maya Culture Amazes in China
original_title: Asombra en China exposición sobre la cultura maya
author: Emir Olivares Alonso
meta_description: More than 800 artifacts, 384 of them Mexican, fill Beijing's Capital Museum, where curators trace parallels between the Maya feathered serpent and the Chinese dragon.
